paragraphs.source_en: Though Takechiyo had been separated from his birth mother at an early age, the Matsudaira clan lavished all its hopes and affection upon him and raised him in the inner castle; even the inner compound was known as “Takechiyo Castle.” But he was only six by traditional reckoning and could not yet ride a horse. paragraphs.source_zh: “主公真是让人绝望。”大久保新八扭过头去自言自语。人们的眼睛也湿润了。

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall endure. You must endure as well. And you children accompanying Takechiyo—do not cause trouble in a strange land.”

units.source_en: “I shall endure.
units.source_zh: “我会忍耐。

units.source_en: You must endure as well.
units.source_zh: 你们也请忍耐。

units.source_en: And you children accompanying Takechiyo—do not cause trouble in a strange land.”
units.source_zh: 陪伴竹千代的孩子们，莫在异乡惹是生非。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我会忍耐。你们也请忍耐。陪伴竹千代的孩子们，莫在异乡惹是生非。”

paragraphs.source_en: The adults swallowed their tears and nodded their assent; but the children did not understand what he meant.

units.source_en: The adults swallowed their tears and nodded their assent;
units.source_zh: 大人们咽下泪水，点头赞同；

units.source_en: but the children did not understand what he meant.
units.source_zh: 但孩子们却不解其中的含义。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大人们咽下泪水，点头赞同；但孩子们却不解其中的含义。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not merely speak of loyalty; protect your young lord with all your hearts. If... if any misfortune should befall him, not one of you is to return alive to Okazaki!”

units.source_en: “Do not merely speak of loyalty; protect your young lord with all your hearts.
units.source_zh: “不能只将忠义挂在口头，要发自内心地保护好幼主。

units.source_en: If... if any misfortune should befall him, not one of you is to return alive to Okazaki!”
units.source_zh: 万一⋯⋯若是幼主发生意外，你们谁也不要活着回到冈崎！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不能只将忠义挂在口头，要发自内心地保护好幼主。万一⋯⋯若是幼主发生意外，你们谁也不要活着回到冈崎！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord!” the children answered in ringing voices.

units.source_en: “Yes, my lord!”
the children answered in ringing voices.
units.source_zh: 孩子们响亮地回答。

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。”孩子们响亮地回答。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then let us set out now!” said Hirotada. The servants brought in sake and cups.

units.source_en: “Then let us set out now!”
units.source_zh: “那么，现在就出发吧！”

units.source_en: said Hirotada.
units.source_zh: 广忠道。

units.source_en: The servants brought in sake and cups.
units.source_zh: 下人们将酒和杯子端了上来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么，现在就出发吧！”广忠道。下人们将酒和杯子端了上来。

paragraphs.source_en: The paper screens were turning white with dawn, and the chill morning air made everyone shiver. Takechiyo watched the movements of everyone in the room with lively interest, a smile never leaving his face.

units.source_en: The paper screens were turning white with dawn, and the chill morning air made everyone shiver.

units.source_en: Takechiyo watched the movements of everyone in the room with lively interest, a smile never leaving his face.
units.source_zh: 竹千代饶有兴趣地观察着座中众人的举动，脸上始终笑盈盈的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 窗纸发白，早晨冰凉的空气令人瑟瑟发抖。竹千代饶有兴趣地观察着座中众人的举动，脸上始终笑盈盈的。

paragraphs.source_en: After the sake had been drunk, Takechiyo led the children out of the inner castle. The adults appeared to have instructed them beforehand: except for five-year-old Matsudaira Yoichirō, they all put on their straw sandals by themselves.

units.source_en: After the sake had been drunk, Takechiyo led the children out of the inner castle.
units.source_zh: 喝完酒，竹千代领着孩子们出了本城。

units.source_en: The adults appeared to have instructed them beforehand: except for five-year-old Matsudaira Yoichirō, they all put on their straw sandals by themselves.
units.source_zh: 大人们似乎已经教过他们，除了五岁的松平与一郎，他们都自己穿上了草鞋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 喝完酒，竹千代领着孩子们出了本城。大人们似乎已经教过他们，除了五岁的松平与一郎，他们都自己穿上了草鞋。

paragraphs.source_en: There were seven child attendants and twenty-one adults in all. Nineteen of the adults would escort Takechiyo to the lodgings at Shiomizaka, where they would hand his party over to the Imagawa clan before returning to Okazaki Castle. Only Ueda Sōkei, who was skilled in medicine, and Kaneda Yosazaemon would accompany him as far as Sunpu. Not long after Takechiyo’s departure, Okazaki arranged for Ishikawa Aki and Amano Jin’emon to travel to Sunpu as special envoys and once again implore Imagawa Yoshimoto to increase the number of guards.

units.source_en: There were seven child attendants and twenty-one adults in all.
units.source_zh: 共七个侍童，二十一个成人。

units.source_en: Nineteen of the adults would escort Takechiyo to the lodgings at Shiomizaka, where they would hand his party over to the Imagawa clan before returning to Okazaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 其中的十九个成人会将竹千代送至潮见坂的下处，在那里将竹千代一行转交给今川家后，便返回冈崎城。

units.source_en: Only Ueda Sōkei, who was skilled in medicine, and Kaneda Yosazaemon would accompany him as far as Sunpu.
units.source_zh: 只有精通医术的上田宗庆和金田与三左卫门二人同行至骏府。

units.source_zh: 竹千代走后不久，冈崎便安排石川安艺和天野甚右卫门作为特使前去骏府，再次恳求今川义元增加护卫人数。

paragraphs.source_zh: 共七个侍童，二十一个成人。其中的十九个成人会将竹千代送至潮见坂的下处，在那里将竹千代一行转交给今川家后，便返回冈崎城。只有精通医术的上田宗庆和金田与三左卫门二人同行至骏府。竹千代走后不久，冈崎便安排石川安艺和天野甚右卫门作为特使前去骏府，再次恳求今川义元增加护卫人数。

paragraphs.source_en: “Takechiyo, take good care of yourself.”

units.source_en: “Takechiyo, take good care of yourself.”
units.source_zh: “竹千代，多保重呀。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “竹千代，多保重呀。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hearing the call, a strange light flashed in Takechiyo’s eyes, and he looked toward Lady Tahara.

units.source_en: Hearing the call, a strange light flashed in Takechiyo’s eyes, and he looked toward Lady Tahara.
units.source_zh: 听到有人叫，竹千代眼睛里放出异样的光芒，向田原夫人那边望去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到有人叫，竹千代眼睛里放出异样的光芒，向田原夫人那边望去。

paragraphs.source_en: “All of you, please take good care of Takechiyo.”

units.source_en: “All of you, please take good care of Takechiyo.”
units.source_zh: “请大家保护好竹千代。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “请大家保护好竹千代。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes!” Young voices answered all around her.

units.source_en: “Yes!”
Young voices answered all around her.
units.source_zh: 周围响起稚嫩的应答声。

paragraphs.source_zh: “是！”周围响起稚嫩的应答声。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not forget, Tokuchiyo. Do not forget what your mother told you.” Lady Abe Jingorō called in a scolding tone to her son, who was following behind Takechiyo. At that moment, someone burst into loud sobs.

units.source_en: “Do not forget, Tokuchiyo. Do not forget what your mother told you.”
units.source_zh: “不要忘了，德千代，不要忘了母亲的话。”

units.source_en: Lady Abe Jingorō called in a scolding tone to her son, who was following behind Takechiyo.
units.source_zh: 阿部甚五郎夫人以训斥的口吻向跟在竹千代身后的儿子喊道。

units.source_en: At that moment, someone burst into loud sobs.
units.source_zh: 这时，不知谁哇地哭出声来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不要忘了，德千代，不要忘了母亲的话。”阿部甚五郎夫人以训斥的口吻向跟在竹千代身后的儿子喊道。这时，不知谁哇地哭出声来。

paragraphs.source_en: Tokuchiyo, solemnly carrying Takechiyo’s small war sword, said to his mother, “Mother, farewell.” His voice sounded almost like singing, and then he walked on.

units.source_en: Tokuchiyo, solemnly carrying Takechiyo’s small war sword, said to his mother, “Mother, farewell.”
units.source_zh: 郑重地提着竹千代小小武刀的德千代对母亲道：“母亲，再会了。”

units.source_en: His voice sounded almost like singing, and then he walked on.
units.source_zh: 他的声音好像唱歌一般，随后便走了过去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 郑重地提着竹千代小小武刀的德千代对母亲道：“母亲，再会了。”他的声音好像唱歌一般，随后便走了过去。

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada did not come outside. Takechiyo’s party went ahead, and everyone else followed behind as though by common consent. It had been the same when Takechiyo’s birth mother left Okazaki; unless someone spoke up, the people would go on following forever.

units.source_zh: 广忠没有跟出来。

units.source_zh: 竹千代一行在前，众人不约而同跟在后边。

units.source_en: It had been the same when Takechiyo’s birth mother left Okazaki; unless someone spoke up, the people would go on following forever.

paragraphs.source_en: Four palanquins were set down before the children. Takechiyo and Abe Tokuchiyo departed in the foremost palanquin. Matsudaira Yoichirō, Amano Matagorō, Matagorō’s younger brother Sannosuke, Hiraiwa Shichinosuke, Ishikawa Yoshichirō, and Sukeemon climbed into the palanquins in turn.

units.source_zh: 松平与一郎、天野又五郎、又五郎之弟三之助、平岩七之助、石川与七郎、助右卫门依次钻进了轿子。
